title: Danny Boy
writers: Frederic Weatherly (lyrics) to the traditional Londonderry Air

evidence.note: Weatherly fitted his lyrics to the Londonderry Air in 1913 and the song was published in 1913 by Boosey & Co.; IMSLP lists the 1913 first publication. First published in the UK.
Second source for the publication year.

famous_use: Judy Garland sang it in Little Nellie Kelly (1940).
